findings.title: Reject decisions whose legacy source binding does not match the requested source
findings.body: The helper accepts a v1 decision as an author proposal after checking only `source.originalPath`. A stale or forged decision for the same original path but a different `legacyPath` (or otherwise mismatched source binding) can therefore supply canonical destinations to the migration ledger and be labeled as an author proposal. Validate the expected legacy path/source binding before returning a suggestion, or pass and validate the authoritative source record here.

findings.title: Do not treat dangling author-decision symlinks as missing records
findings.body: `existsSync` follows symlinks, so a dangling symlink at the author-decision path returns false and causes this helper to return `null`. The generator then falls back to filename-based migration guidance instead of failing closed for malformed/symlinked author metadata. Inspect the path with `lstatSync` (and guard parent components) before deciding it is absent so dangling symlinks are rejected like other symlinks.

overall_explanation: The new proposal helper can emit or fall back from invalid author metadata without enforcing the intended exact source-binding and symlink controls.
